data.reason: Leases and repairs aircraft engines for airlines; no casino or business aircraft modification overlap.
Leases commercial aircraft engines to airlines; asset-leasing model differs from business aircraft modification and casino management.
Aircraft engine leasing plus maintenance, repair and parts for operators, adjacent aviation aftermarket business.

Butler National is a diversified holding company: FAA-approved aircraft modifications, avionics and defense electronics manufacturing, and Kansas casino management. Willis Lease is an asset-owning lessor of commercial jet engines to airlines, with some engine repair and parts sales. Both are in aviation, but Willis earns its money from lease payments on engines it owns. Butler earns it from engineering and modification work, electronics manufacturing and management fees. The products differ (engine leasing versus modifications and avionics), and so do the main buyers (airlines and lessors versus business-jet owners, OEMs and defense). Willis has nothing that matches the casino business.

P1.2.text: Butler National Corporation specializes in aerospace solutions and management services, including modifications.

P1.3.text: AVCON RECEIVES FAA STC FOR HONEYWELL AEROSPACE REPLACEMENT EGPWS ON BOMBARDIER AND LEARJET AIRCRAFT

P1.4.text: BUTLER NATIONAL CORPORATION ANNOUNCES INCREASE TO STOCK REPURCHASE PROGRAM

P1.5.text: Butler National Corporation is an aerospace-focused holding company that delivers engineering, aircraft modifications, electrical systems integration, commercial and defense electronics, and professional management services. Our businesses support commercial operators, defense partners, and original equipment manufacturers.

P1.6.text: Our primary operations include Avcon Industries, BNC Tempe, and the professional services segment anchored by the Boot Hill Casino. Together, these businesses combine advanced engineering with reliable service delivery to support long-term growth.

P1.8.text: Butler National Corporation is comprised of multiple key subsidiaries operating across industries such as aerospace, avionics, defense, and professional services.

P1.9.text: Avcon provides FAA-approved aircraft modifications, engineering, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions.

P1.10.text: BNC Tempe supplies commercial and defense electronics, wiring harnesses, and system controls to OEMs and government agencies.

P1.11.text: Our professional services segment provides management and operational expertise in gaming and hospitality.

P1.12.text: Butler National offers opportunities across engineering, avionics, electronics manufacturing, and management services. Explore open roles across our business units.

P1.13.text: Subscribe to receive Butler National Corporation updates and investor communications.

P2.2.text: Aerospace expertise in designing, manufacturing, and servicing aviation products and professional services, managing Boot Hill Casino.

P2.3.text: Butler National Corporation is a public holding company with more than six decades of experience in aerospace engineering, aircraft modifications, avionics integration, special purpose electronics design and manufacturing, and professional gaming management services.

P2.4.text: Butler National is OTCQX listed under the ticker BUKS.

P2.5.text: Butler National oversees subsidiaries that provide:

P2.6.text: Aircraft modifications, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions

P2.7.text: Commercial and defense electronics, wire/cable harness assemblies, and system components

P2.8.text: Professional management services for gaming operations

P2.9.text: This combination of engineering capability and disciplined operational management supports sustainable growth across our business segments.

P2.10.text: Our governance framework includes established committees, corporate policies, charters, and a code of ethics that guide responsible conduct across all subsidiaries.

P2.11.text: Our operating subsidiaries focus on aerospace engineering and modifications, commercial electronics, and professional management services.

P2.12.text: Avcon provides FAA approved aircraft modifications, engineering, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions.

P3.2.text: Operates Avcon Inc. and Butler Avionics, supplies commercial and defense electronics, manages Boot Hill Casino & Resort, and runs KC Machine.

P3.3.text: Butler National Corporation oversees a group of aerospace and professional services subsidiaries that support commercial operators, defense partners, original equipment manufacturers and agencies around the world. Our primary operations focus on aircraft engineering and modifications, avionics integration, and commercial electronics design and manufacturing, with additional services provided through our professional management segment.

P3.4.text: Our aerospace subsidiaries deliver engineering, FAA-approved aircraft modifications, avionics integration, commercial electronics, wiring systems, and special mission solutions. These businesses support a broad range of commercial, defense, and government programs.

P3.5.text: Avcon provides FAA-approved aircraft modifications, engineering, systems integration and avionics for commercial and defense operators. The team delivers reliable airframe upgrades and mission solutions for a wide range of aircraft.

P3.8.text: Butler National – Tempe manufactures commercial and defense electronics, wiring and cabling harnesses, and system components for OEMs and government agencies. The team produces both custom assemblies and commercial off-the-shelf solutions.

P3.10.text: Butler Avionics provides avionics sales, installations, upgrades, and repair services, supporting Avcon’s engineering and aircraft modification programs as well as general aviation customers.

P3.11.text: Butler Machine is an ITAR registered, ISO certified machine shop providing precision CNC machining, laser marking, and quality inspection

P1.1.text: WLFC | Leading Global Aircraft Engine Leasing & Services

P1.2.text: Willis Lease Finance Corporation: Your partner for aviation services and financing solutions, supporting fleet management and maintenance challenges.

P1.3.text: Helping to connect the world through sustainable flight.

P1.4.text: We leverage our expert knowledge of aviation to provide customers bold and tailored solutions spanning the entire asset lifecycle.

P1.5.text: Minimize Downtime and Maximize your Airline

P1.6.text: As an aircraft fleet manager for a commercial airline or dedicated freight service, you know all too well that aircraft only generate revenue when flying. Any downtime is an immediate impact to your bottom line, whether it is an aircraft-on-ground (AOG) situation, unplanned repairs, scheduled maintenance, mandated service bulletins, or even a delayed gate turn at an airport. Minimizing and managing that downtime is critical to protecting revenue and maximizing customer confidence in your airline’s brand.

P1.7.text: Save millions in repair costs with leased engines

P1.8.text: Get 24/7 access to engines, repair services, fleeting planning, technical records, storage, and consulting

P1.9.text: Keep aircraft operational and build customer confidence in your airline

P1.10.text: As the most expensive component on your aircraft, jet engines present a special challenge in terms of required maintenance due to many life-limited parts and a general reduction in power and efficiency over time. Since you cannot afford for the airframe to sit idle while the engines are maintained, a lease or purchase of new ones can keep your aircraft in service.

P1.11.text: What you need is an aviation services partner with a fully integrated portfolio of products, services, and aircraft financing to meet the demanding challenges of fleet management and maintenance.

P1.12.text: You deserve an Aviation Services Partner to keep your aircraft flying and operational.

P1.13.text: WLFC offers a broad range of aircraft and engine services to its customers worldwide. Whether it is parts, jet engines, or entire aircraft, we provide fully tailored solutions to your specific aviation asset challenges from first cycle to recycle.

P1.14.text: We offer 24/7 AOG support. As the largest independent lessor of commercial aircraft jet engines, we have the power when and where you need it.

P1.15.text: We bring outstanding capital availability, a worldwide sales force, and an experienced management team to partner with you for the best solution.

P1.17.text: We are a pioneer in the aviation services industry – and that’s no exaggeration. We were the first to lease jet engines to commercial operators and our record of innovation continues today.

P1.18.text: For example, with ConstantAccess®, customers can lease jet engines they need, when they need them. Customers have preferred access, on demand, to our worldwide portfolio of engines with availability guaranteed – enabling you to focus on flying.

P1.19.text: With ConstantThrust®, we cover the cost and risk of jet engine maintenance by replacing a removed engine with a serviceable engine from our assets - saving airline customers the significant time, money, and risk associated with engine heavy maintenance.

P1.20.text: "With innovative solutions such as Willis Lease’s Revolving Credit Lease and ConstantAccess® programs supporting the launch of our B737MAX operations, we are confident going forward that we have partnered with the industry leader that delivers for its customers.”

P1.22.text: "Willis Lease’s ConstantThrust® aircraft and engine program is the perfect solution for TAG Airlines’ ATR 72-500 fleet addition. We are fortunate to work with industry experts such as the Willis Team in this endeavor. We look forward to continuing to work on creative fleet solutions as we expand our business.”

P1.24.text: We have over 45 years in the business, with extensive experience and expertise in the industry. Many of our executives started as aviation mechanics, so we understand your specific airplane issues.
